abstract: The human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line, NEC14 can be induced to morphologically differentiate by the addition of 10(-2) M N,N'-hexamethylene-bis-acetamide (HMBA) in vitro. The expression of several cellular oncogenes (c-onc) in NEC14 cells was examined after induction of differentiation by HMBA. The level of N-myc expression was the highest in undifferentiated cells but decreased transiently to less than 1/10 of the original level shortly after the induction of differentiation. To investigate the role of the transient decrease in N-myc level on NEC14 cell differentiation, a chimeric human N-myc gene in which transcription is initiated at the human beta-actin gene promoter was constructed and introduced into NEC14 cells. Several transformants expressing the exogenous N-myc gene constitutively were established. These transformants showed 10- to 70-fold increases in plating efficiency and shorter population doubling times as compared with the parental NEC14 cells. The transformants were hard to induce, spontaneously differentiated cells on the periphery of cell clusters in culture, unlike parental NEC14 cells, and took longer for HMBA-induced morphological differentiation. The populations of the cells expressing HLA and SSEA-1 antigens increased from 10%-20% to nearly 100% in NEC14 cells after the induction of differentiation, while the populations expressing these antigens increased only to 50%-60% in one of the transformants, S11. The transformants gained an increased tumorigenic potential in nude mice, and the tumors produced consisted exclusively of EC stem cells. These results suggest that the additional expression of the exogenous N-myc gene (increased about two-fold) confers the more transformed state on the cells.
abstract_ja: ヒト胎児性癌（EC）細胞株NEC14は、N,N'-ヘキサメチレンビスアセトアミド（HMBA）10^-2 Mの添加によりin vitroで形態学的に分化誘導されうる。分化誘導後、NEC14細胞における数種の細胞癌遺伝子（c-onc）の発現を検討した。N-mycの発現は未分化細胞で最も高かったが、分化誘導直後に一過性に1/10未満まで低下した。N-mycの一過性の低下が分化に果たす役割を調べるため、ヒトβアクチン遺伝子プロモーターから転写が開始するキメラ型ヒトN-mycを構築し、NEC14細胞に導入した。恒常的に外来性N-mycを発現する形質転換体を樹立した。これらの形質転換体は親株NEC14と比べ、プレーティング効率が10〜70倍に上昇し、倍加時間が短縮した。形質転換体は分化誘導されにくく、親株と異なり細胞クラスターの周縁で自然に分化する細胞が出現し、HMBAによる形態学的分化にも時間がかかった。分化誘導後、HLAおよびSSEA-1抗原陽性細胞の割合はNEC14で10〜20%から約100%に増加したが、形質転換体の一つ（S11）では50〜60%までしか増加しなかった。形質転換体はヌードマウスでの腫瘍原性が増加し、生じた腫瘍は胎児性癌幹細胞のみから構成された。これらの結果は、外来性N-mycの追加発現（約2倍増）が、細胞により形質転換した状態を与えることを示唆している。
